package sandbox

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

// WorkspaceFile represents a file in workspace.
type WorkspaceFile = answeruc.WorkspaceFile
type WorkspaceSnapshot = answeruc.WorkspaceSnapshot

// Client provides access to sandbox service.
type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
	NATSConn      interface{} // Will be NATS connection
}

// NewClient creates a new sandbox client.
func NewClient(baseURL, internalToken string) *Client {
	return &Client{
		BaseURL:       baseURL,
		InternalToken: internalToken,
		HTTPClient: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// GetSnapshot fetches workspace files snapshot.
func (c *Client) GetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) (WorkspaceSnapshot, error) {
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/sandboxes/%s/snapshot", c.BaseURL, sandboxID)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return WorkspaceSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}

	resp, err := c.HTTPClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return WorkspaceSnapshot{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return WorkspaceSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("snapshot failed: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var result WorkspaceSnapshot
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return WorkspaceSnapshot{}, err
	}

	return result, nil
}
